assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.91, and I49.5.
The service addresses the pre-service authorization requirement denied under CO-197.
